name: brisk-schedules
description: BriskSchedules - Premium Free Employee Scheduling & Time Clock System

scripts.test:syntax: node -c server.js seed.js js/app.js js/database.js js/scheduler.js js/supabase-client.js js/swaps.js js/opal_roster_workflows.js js/pomelli_roster_broadcaster.js js/mixboard_roster_studio.js sw.js
scripts.roster:check: npm run test:syntax && npm run roster:qa
scripts.test:mcp: node -e "fetch('https://woywoyamcalroster.vercel.app/api/mcp', {method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body:JSON.stringify({jsonrpc:'2.0', id:1, method:'tools/call', params:{name:'list_employees', arguments:{}}})}).then(r=>r.json()).then(d=>console.log(JSON.stringify(d, null, 2))).catch(console.error)"
scripts.deploy:prod: powershell -Command "Move-Item -Path node_modules -Destination ..\temp_brisk_nm -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Move-Item -Path _node_modules_tmp -Destination ..\temp_brisk_nm -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; try { vercel --prod --yes } finally { Move-Item -Path ..\temp_brisk_nm -Destination node_modules -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"
scripts.deploy: git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin main && vercel --prod --yes --cwd .
scripts.commit:mobile: git add css/styles.css index.html js/app.js js/database.js api/schedule/leave/index.ts sw.js scripts/check_app.js package.json && git commit -m "fix(leave): v9.1.7 - serverless leave decision endpoint & durable state persistence [auto]" && git push origin main && vercel --prod --yes --cwd .
scripts.sync-deploy: git reset HEAD~1 && git add ../.gitignore ../AGENTS.md . && git commit -m "fix: resilient login profile recovery, v8.5.1 cache-busting, and mcp api [auto]" && git push origin main
scripts.vercel-link: vercel link --yes --scope mcjp --project woywoyamcalroster && vercel git connect https://github.com/pharmotago/knowledge_hub --yes
